title: Refunds Specialist
description:
ROLE

Property Leads is a fast-growing startup building cutting-edge lead generation and data solutions for the real estate industry. We're a lean, high-impact team of 20, solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and growth.


We’re looking for an exceptional communicator and lead prospector capable of achieving remarkable results in the Refunds Specialist role at Property Leads. The successful candidate in this role must know that this is not a traditional 9 am to 5 pm job– evening and weekend work are required, and 40-60 hours per week are required.


You’ll work closely with our Senior Refund Coordinator and Customer Success Manager to collect data through text, phone calls, and email communication to process refunds accurately and efficiently.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm the status of selling their home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to determine if they own the home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm if a mobile home for sale does/does not come with the land it sits on.
  • Move all prospects to the proper pipeline stage via CRM throughout the day.
  • Maintain a clear, up-to-date, and accurate pipeline in our CRM.
  • Follow up diligently and consistently with sellers over extended periods.
  • Document all interactions with prospects and clients in the CRM's “notes” section, escalating to Support or the Senior Refunds Coordinator as needed.
  • Process refunds with integrity, according to the refund policy.


RESULTS

  • Reach sellers promptly to help determine the outcome of declining/approving a refund request.
  • All sellers are promptly followed up with.
  • There is an effective line of communication between this role and the Senior Refunds Coordinator in which all necessary information is communicated promptly.
  • Continuously improve communication skills (Crucial Conversations book, etc.)
  • All internal communication cycles are adequately followed.


REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven work experience with cold calling or phone sales.
  • Proven work experience with text messaging/emailing in English.
  • You must enjoy being on the phone and speaking to sellers.
  • Excellent communication skills, including listening and facing conflict head-on.
  • Excellent at building rapport.
  • Willing to work in a fast-paced environment and rapidly grow.
  • Open to learning new processes in cold calling/seller outreach.
  • Self-sufficient and able to properly manage one’s own time.
  • Well-organized and able to maintain a pipeline that the Refunds Coordinator and sales Manager can observe and understand.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Experience as a real estate investor is preferred but optional.
  • Must pass written and verbal exams.

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Auditors of Certificates of Insurance


HOW THIS POSITION HELPS JONES SUCCEED

As an Auditor of Certificates of Insurance (COI) you will be responsible for verifying that the documents provided by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors in our platform have the necessary coverage required by our customers.


All the necessary training to perform the necessary tasks will be offered.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The high-level goal for this role is to help the company to deliver accurate audit resolutions in a timely manner.


  • This role demands a high level of commitment and dedication; this is a full-time, hands-on position requiring 40 hours per week, with occasional after-hours work as needed (including additional compensation).
  • This is not a role for someone seeking a casual or part-time opportunity; it demands undivided attention and cannot be reconciled with concurrent employment commitments


Be prepared for a fast-paced environment and to seek process improvements and personal development actively.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

  • Be detail-oriented. High level of thoroughness, accuracy, organization, and productivity;
  • Communicate fluently in English (advanced written skills);

  • Eager to learn and keen on coaching and feedback;
  • Open to failure and rejection in the spirit of learning, progress, and resilienceç

  • Build subject-matter expertise in an area of real estate operations and insurance that is lucrative and is undergoing serious digital transformation;

  • Mentorship from talented leaders;
  • Be part of an award-winning company that is tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month;
  • Be part of a lean and agile team, with a strong culture;
  • Help Jones execute a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world;
  • Gain a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.



OUR CULTURE

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their roles and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward.

  • We get things done, period, full stop
  • We give help generously
  • We fall in love with customer problems

  • We take care of ourselves with rest, time away from work and simply having fun



ABOUT JONES

Jones helps real estate and construction firms to remove the barrier of insurance compliance through one software application that integrates with core operating systems. We envision a world where every property and construction site is connected by a network of insurance data enabling individuals to find, check and verify compliance instantly. Over 1 billion square feet of real estate relies on Jones daily, including firms such as Empire State Realty, Tishman Speyer, JLL, Rudin Management, and many more.

description:

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.

  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.


Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.

Nosso trabalho vai além de “fotos bonitas”: entregamos uma experiência afetiva, conduzida com acolhimento e um olhar atento aos detalhes, ao comportamento e ao conforto do animal.

Cada ensaio é planejado de forma personalizada, para que o resultado traduza verdade, conexão e história. 


Objetivo da função

Ser a pessoa responsável por converter leads em sessões agendadas , com atendimento rápido, consultivo e com follow-up consistente, fazendo prospecção ativa com a base de clientes recorrentes.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender leads via WhatsApp/Instagram/Telefone com rapidez e clareza.
  • Fazer qualificação (perfil do tutor, tipo de pet, objetivo, disponibilidade, urgência).
  • Apresentar pacotes/condições e conduzir a negociação até o fechamento.
  • Agendar sessões e coordenar agenda com a equipe desde o início até a entrega final das fotos.
  • Registrar tudo em CRM/planilha (etapa do lead, motivo de perda, status do pagamento).
  • Fazer follow-up diário dos leads abertos.
  • Garantir o básico do pós-venda: confirmação de sessão, checklist do cliente, alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Sinalizar gargalos para o marketing (objeções recorrentes, etapas que travam conversão).

Indicadores de sucesso (KPIs)

  • Tempo de primeira resposta: meta de 5 minutos em horário comercial.
  • Taxa de conversão Lead → Agendamento/Fechamento: meta de 15%
  • Follow-up diário: 90% de leads sem ficar “parado”.
  • Organização do funil: 100% dos leads com etapa definida e motivo de perda registrado.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com atendimento comercial (WhatsApp/DM) e fechamento .
  • Escrita objetiva e profissional (sem enrolação, sem “texto pronto genérico”).
  • Organização para trabalhar com funil, agenda e rotina de follow-up .
  • Conforto com metas e remuneração variável.
  • Equipamento e internet para trabalho (nos dias remotos).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com negócios de serviço/agenda (estética, saúde, fotografia, eventos).
  • Experiência com CRM (Canva, Notion, Trello, etc.).

Remuneração (PJ)

  • Fixo mensal: R$ 1.800,00
  • Comissão por meta de faturamento

Processo seletivo

  • Triagem pelo
  • Conversa rápida (15–20 min)
  • Teste prático simples (organização de funil + simulação de atendimento)
  • Entrevista final com sócios

Como se candidatar

Enviar (currículo/) + uma mensagem curta respondendo:

  • Qual sua experiência com atendimento e vendas por WhatsApp?
  • Qual resultado/indicador você já bateu em função comercial?

title: Template Designer Intern
description:

Ao integrar IA e conformidade (compliance) automatizada desde a concepção criativa até a ativação, capacitamos marcas a lançar campanhas de alto impacto e dentro das normas com velocidade e inteligência sem precedentes.


Nossa plataforma conta com a confiança das principais agências e anunciantes do mundo para controlar e distribuir conteúdo publicitário em mais de 100 países. Com mais de 230 funcionários em 21 escritórios — de Londres às Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico — estamos mudando fundamentalmente a forma como a publicidade funciona.


O que você fará

Como Estagiário(a) de Template Design, você ajudará a criar e otimizar templates para clientes. Você participará de projetos de onboarding criativo e auxiliará no treinamento de novos clientes que utilizam nossa ferramenta self-service de Template Designer. Além disso, você será um ponto de contato para suporte e dúvidas técnicas sobre a ferramenta.

Durante seu estágio, você aprenderá:


  • Como construir templates dinâmicos para diversos clientes globais.
  • Como guiar novos clientes através do processo de onboarding criativo.
  • Como fornecer treinamento especializado e suporte técnico sobre nossa ferramenta de design.


O que você traz (Perfil desejado)

  • Formação: Você está cursando ensino superior ou se formou recentemente em áreas correlatas (Design, Publicidade, Marketing,, etc.).
  • Experiência em Design: Familiaridade com ferramentas como Photoshop, InDesign, Figma ou softwares similares.
  • Familiarizado com Automação: Você gosta de otimizar processos e torná-los mais eficientes através da tecnologia.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Você gosta de interagir com pessoas, dar treinamentos e solucionar dúvidas de clientes.
  • Idiomas: Português nativo e proficiência em Inglês e Espanhol.
  • Atenção aos detalhes: Você tem um olhar apurado para design e garante que todos os templates tenham acabamento profissional.
  • Vontade de crescer: Mentalidade curiosa e motivação para desenvolver novas habilidades técnicas e de atendimento ao cliente.


Sobre nossa solução de automação criativa

  • O desafio: Gargalos criativos e operações manuais de Ad Ops geram sobrecarga nas equipes e prejudicam a performance das campanhas. O ciclo infinito de revisões impede que as marcas escalem o que realmente funciona.
  • Nossa solução: Construímos uma plataforma all-in-one para produzir, personalizar e lançar anúncios de alta performance em todos os canais — de redes sociais e display a vídeo e DOOH. Unificamos os fluxos de criação e mídia, permitindo que marcas passem de um único criativo mestre para variações ilimitadas em minutos.
  • Seu impacto: Você estará no coração da nossa missão de libertar a criatividade. Você capacitará nossos clientes a superar a concorrência através de ferramentas que transformam dados em anúncios personalizados de alto impacto em escala.


Nosso DNA: Como trabalhamos

Nossos valores são os princípios que guiam nossas decisões e interações todos os dias:

  • Mova-se com inteligência (Move smart): A hesitação mata o ritmo. Combinamos velocidade com inteligência, transformando desafios complexos em soluções automatizadas.
  • Defina o amanhã (Define tomorrow): Não estamos aqui para atender expectativas, mas para redefini-las. Buscamos qualidade, segurança e escala sem precedentes.
  • Melhores juntos (Be better together): O sucesso se multiplica quando compartilhado. Através da colaboração aberta e apoio mútuo, transformamos potencial individual em conquista coletiva.
  • Mude o que é possível (Change what’s possible): A criatividade impulsiona a humanidade. Nossa tecnologia existe para amplificá-la e permitir que ela decole.

I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.

  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.

title: Over-the Counter (OTC) Sales Specialist
description:
Mackay Marine is a global marine electronics service company with more than 500 employees across 60 service depots in twenty-two (22) countries, including the America's, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Mackay offers competitive salaries plus overtime, and benefits such as health/dental insurance, holiday leave, meal and transportation vouchers are available as well.

Mackay is currently seeking a fulltime and experienced Marine Over the Counter (OTC) Specialist who is proficient in English, to work onsite at our Rio location. Individuals with the skills and qualifications outlined below are encouraged to apply.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB SUMMARY

The OTC Specialist is an onsite, non-managerial position which reports to the Managing Director for Brazil. The responsibilities of the OTC Specialist include but are not limited to communicating directly with our customers to answer questions concerning the availability, price, and use of merchandise as well as providing technical guidance, timely quotations, and comprehensive proposals. Will process over-the-counter transactions, special orders, phone-in and internet sales orders as well as inter-company transfers. Will support other team members, customers and company accounts with parts ordering and fulfillment to support our business.

Responsibilities will also include material handling and shipping/receiving of goods which includes physical lifting, handling of boxes, pallet jacks and may include activities on ladders, lifts, forklift, power tools, hand tools, carrying and moving of parts and equipment.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Acts as the point of contact for customer sales, service, and information requests to ensure that customer needs are fulfilled with speed and professionalism.
  • Assist in the research of basic technical issues on products and service. Collect symptoms of customer problems and facilitate repairs.
  • Assist with incoming sales prospects or customer calls when outside sales staff are out of the office.
  • Provide customer quotes, proposals, and will follow up in a timely manner.
  • Build the business by identifying revenue opportunities within the marine industry.
  • Assist with the shipping and receiving functions to help facilitate the trafficking and accountability for all materials received and delivered for customer orders, inventory, repairs, or for internal use.
  • Direct service requests the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain work area and stockroom in a clean and orderly fashion.
  • Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped using Mackay’s ERP system.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST SKILLS NEEDED:

  • Prior knowledge of Marine electronic equipment is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as product brochures, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, etc.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage.
  • Attention to detail and ability to organize materials effectively and efficiently.
  • Excellent customer service, communication (both oral and written), organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Two years of post-secondary education.
  • Electronics and/or marine background preferred.
  • Three years of inside or counter sales experience.
  • Good computer and Internet skills
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.


Applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.  Successful completion of a thorough background check will be required upon acceptance of an employment offer.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:

You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .

  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.

About Us

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Senior Estimator

5+ years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in estimating, project controls, and data analytics)

This is not a typical VA task role .

This role requires someone comfortable working with driven founders, executives, and senior sales professionals from the US and Europe .

You must be comfortable with:

• strategic discussions

• extremely organized

Each operator manages up to three founders or senior sales professionals .

Typical monthly workload per client:

This is a relationship and communication management role , not heavy operational labor.


Compensation


Salary: 3,700 BRL / month

Full-time role.

Because this is a high-trust position supporting founders and senior sales professionals directly:

outside client work is not permitted.

You will work directly with founders and senior sales professionals building companies in:

title: Technical BIM Designer / Computational Revit Specialist
description:
Role Overview


The Technical BIM Designer will support Ecotone’s technical drafting and modeling workflows by developing detailed Revit models, coordinating with engineering consultants, and implementing automation tools that improve production efficiency and model quality.


This role requires a strong understanding of construction documentation, engineering coordination, and fabrication-oriented modeling , along with the ability to develop computational workflows using Dynamo.


Candidates should be comfortable working in technically complex BIM environments where models directly support construction execution.



Requirements



Advanced Revit Expertise


Applicants must demonstrate strong professional proficiency in Revit modeling and documentation within architectural or construction environments.


Candidates should have significant experience with:


• Worksharing environments

• Complex family creation

• Advanced schedules and parameter management

• Maintaining model integrity across multidisciplinary teams



Dynamo Automation


Proven experience developing and maintaining Dynamo graphs to automate repetitive modeling and documentation workflows.


Candidates should be comfortable using Dynamo to:


• automate documentation tasks

• streamline modeling workflows

• enforce BIM standards

• reduce manual drafting work




Computational BIM Workflow Experience


Experience implementing data-driven BIM processes using Dynamo or similar tools to manage parameters, enforce standards, and perform automated quality control checks within large Revit models.




Design-Build Project Experience


Experience working in design-build or construction-integrated environments where BIM models directly support construction documentation, coordination, and fabrication.


Candidates should understand how digital models translate into construction outcomes.




Construction Documentation and Technical Detailing


Strong experience producing detailed construction documents in Revit.


Candidates should be comfortable developing:


• wall assemblies

• sections and details

• millwork and specialty architectural systems

• coordination details with engineering systems




MEP and Engineering Coordination


Demonstrated experience coordinating architectural models with mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural systems within multidisciplinary BIM environments.


Candidates should be able to identify and resolve system conflicts directly within the BIM model.




Fabrication-Oriented Modeling


Experience producing highly detailed models that support:


• shop drawing development

• prefabrication workflows

• contractor installation and coordination




Buildability Awareness


Working knowledge of construction sequencing, material tolerances, installation constraints, and contractor workflows.


Models and drawings must reflect real-world construction logic, not conceptual architecture.




Professional Experience Requirement


This role is intended for experienced BIM professionals.


Applicants who are early in their careers, seeking training in Revit fundamentals, or looking for entry-level drafting roles will not be considered.




Bonus Qualifications



Python within Dynamo


Ability to write custom Python scripts inside Dynamo to extend functionality and bypass node limitations.




Revit API Development


Experience developing custom automation tools or add-ins using the Revit API.




Why Work at Ecotone


Ecotone offers the opportunity to work on technically complex projects that integrate architecture, engineering coordination, fabrication, and construction.


Team members gain exposure to:


• advanced BIM workflows

• construction-integrated design environments

• highly specialized architectural systems

• real-world design-build problem solving

title: Latam-focused research intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group
Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.Workplace:Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-siteContract Type:InternshipPosition Description
We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus onLatin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.
The selected candidate must benative orfluent in Spanish and English (mandatory)and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.Please note:Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.Main Responsibilities
·Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.
·Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.
·Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.
·Track the performance and movements of financial assets.
·Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.
·Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.
·Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.
·Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.Requirements
·Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).
·Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.
·Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.
·Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.
·Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.
·Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).
·Clear and structured written communication skills.
·Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.Differentials
·Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.
·Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.
·Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).Benefits
·Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.
·Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in Lat Am.
·Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.
·Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

description:
A CK é uma marca norte-americana fundada em 1968 na cidade de Nova York, e que manteve sua iconicidade e atemporalidade até os dias atuais. Este nome se expandiu ao redor do mundo, e por isso hoje está presente em vários países, inclusive no Brasil.
Nacionalmente contamos com +2.000 pontos de venda, além de termos nossa matriz corporativa presente na cidade de São Paulo, e contarmos com 2 centros de distribuição: um em Cotia/SP, e outro em Serra/ES.

title: Java fullstack developer (angular)
description:

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
Hands-on experience with Postgre SQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, and Bedrock.
Experience using My Batis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of Rx JS and Observables.

Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using Rx JS and Observables.
Implement and manage data persistence using Postgre SQL, My Batis, Liquibase, and Redis.
Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
Qualifications
Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, Postgre SQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch), Angular (v19 or similar), Rx JS / Observables, My Batis and Liquibase.
Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.

About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced life support and emergency care training;
Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;

Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Senior azure cloud architect
description:
About You
You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams.
You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
Strong experience with Azure Dev Ops, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
Design and maintain multi-stage Azure Dev Ops pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
Collaborate with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
Qualifications
5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
Experience with Azure Dev Ops and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
Advanced English proficiency.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Master data modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location
Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.
Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM Info Sphere Data Architect, SAP Power Designer, or similar tools.
Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.
Desired Qualifications
Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or My SQL.
Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Site manager (projetos industriais)
description:

Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:

Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento e revisão de projetos multidisciplinares industriais (civil, mecânico, elétrico, instrumentação e automação), buscando ganhos de produtividade, padronização de processos construtivos, inovação tecnológica e redução de riscos operacionais e de montagem;
Definir e coordenar a matriz de riscos dos elementos de obras industriais, antecipando falhas potenciais em interfaces disciplinares, riscos de montagem mecânica, riscos de segurança operacional, desvios de performance dos equipamentos e impactos financeiros;
Assegurar a execução com qualidade dos serviços, garantindo conformidade com especificações técnicas, normas internacionais aplicáveis, metodologias executivas específicas que atendam aos requisitos operacionais da planta em construção;
Compatibilizar o projeto com o escopo contratual, analisando a viabilidade das metodologias de montagem, interligações de sistemas e sequenciamento construtivo, otimizando soluções técnicas para reduzir custos, retrabalhos e riscos de parada ou atraso de startup;
Atuar em parceria com Suprimentos na especificação técnica e aquisição de materiais e equipamentos, buscando fornecedores internacionais, garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade normativa, custo-benefício e gestão eficiente de estoque e entregas;
Aplicar conhecimentos das principais modalidades contratuais utilizadas em obras industriais, desenhando estratégias adequadas para cada contexto e suas interfaces multidisciplinares, mantendo profundo conhecimento do contrato;
Elaborar e sustentar reinvindicações (claims) e aditivos, quando necessário, visando a manutenção do equilíbrio contratual e a proteção dos indicadores de performance do projeto;
Realizar a gestão contratual rigorosa com subcontratados, assegurando cumprimento de obrigações técnicas, regulatórias e de SMS, mitigando passivos e garantindo medições precisas, rastreáveis e conformes ao avanço físico real;
Compreender o desempenho econômico-financeiro de projetos industriais, analisando CAPEX, OPEX, curva S integrada por disciplina, impactos de equipamentos estratégicos e variações cambiais em contratos internacionais.
Manter relacionamento transparente com sindicatos, órgãos reguladores, Corpo de Bombeiros, órgãos ambientais e auditorias técnicas, garantindo observância à legislação trabalhista, NR’s e normas industriais aplicáveis, preservando a segurança empresarial;
Priorizar a Segurança do Trabalho desde as fases de engenharia até a execução, implantando cultura de intolerância a acidentes, gestão de energias perigosas, análises de risco operacionais e práticas avançadas de controle de processo;
Coordenar atividades de pré-comissionamento e completação mecânica, desenvolve planos e procedimentos de comissionamento, manuais de operação e manutenção, matrizes de testes e controles rigorosos de qualidade e riscos operacionais;
Planejar e gerenciar a partida da planta industrial, coordenando testes operacionais, energização de sistemas elétricos, calibração de instrumentos, testes de performance e integração com a equipe de operação, garantindo entrega segura e funcional ao cliente.

Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Civil, Elétrica, Produção ou correlatas;
Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
Sólida experiência como Site Manager em obras do ramo industrial, sobretudo em plantas químicas e/ou petroquímicas;
Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

:

Experiência em. NET

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:
Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Experiência com tecnologias específicas utilizadas na clínica (ex: ultrassom microfocado, radiofrequência etc.).
Portfólio de casos de sucesso.

title: Especialista de planejamento tributário
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Acompanhamento e análise de alterações na legislação tributária e consultoria interna;
Atuação estratégica junto a assessores externos na elaboração de pareceres e acompanhamento de fiscalizações;
Atendimento a auditorias e controle de processos tributários;
Estruturação de novas atividades, serviços e novos empreendimentos multiuso, incluindo pesquisa da legislação;
Análise contratual e simulação da alternativa fiscal mais eficiente;
Atuação em projetos de M& A, com foco em reestruturações societárias preparatórias para aquisições e vendas de ativos;
Identificação de oportunidades e condução da implementação de projetos, a fim de garantir a maximização dos resultados e a redução de riscos fiscais.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.
Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.
A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

6. Preparar relatórios regulares sobre desempenho dos controles internos, com análises e recomendações à alta administração.
7. Colaborar com TI para integrar controles internos aos sistemas corporativos, promovendo abordagem sistêmica.
8. Avaliar eficiência e eficácia dos processos de negócio, propondo melhorias para otimização e redução de riscos.
9. Facilitar auditorias externas, garantindo fornecimento de documentação e informações necessárias.

title: Lower school makerspace teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).
The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences. Holds a Bachelor’s degree in Pedagogy and Arts, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics.
Has 3–5 years of qualified teaching experience, preferably in an international school context.
A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects. If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

title: Service engineer
description:
Job Summary:
The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.
In this role, your responsibilities will be:
Onboard Service Execution:
Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations. Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution:
Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials. Reports / Administrative Activities:
Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner. Participation in FAT Tests: Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class. Training:
Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
Participate in, observe, and comply with the company’s health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.
Who You Are:
You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.
For this role, you will need:
Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments.
Availability to work overtime, as needed.
Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
Work location: Rio de Janeiro.
Our Culture and Commitment to You:
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

title: Hr training analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst
Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances;
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
Life Insurance;
Annual Bonus;
Private Pension Plan;
Childcare Allowance.
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Senior ai/ml developer
description:

title: Consultor(a) comercial
description:
Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e negócios.
Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) Comerciais com perfil consultivo, capazes de atuar em vendas complexas, de alto valor agregado , conectando desafios estratégicos de clientes às melhores soluções em talentos.
Quem somos e o que fazemos
Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.
Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.
O que oferecemos

Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;
Modelo de trabalho híbrido;
Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;
Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança;
Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais;
Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo;
Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.
Suas responsabilidades
Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:
Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em vendas complexas e consultivas ; Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;
Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;
Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;
Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;
Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;
Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;
Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.
Quem procuramos
Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:

Experiência prévia em vendas B2 B complexas ou consultivas;
Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;
Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;
Habilidade para construir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;
Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório.
Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;
Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;
Graduação completa;
Inglês avançado.
Nosso compromisso com a diversidade
Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.
Faça parte da nossa história
Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.
