title: Technical product manager (temporary contract)
description:
About You
You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.
You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.
You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.
Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure Dev Ops for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.
Qualifications
Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure Dev Ops for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.
Additional Information
About Us
We Are Engineered Different.
At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

Academic Background:In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.

Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.What We Offer:

Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!Come join us!

Build the business by identifying revenue opportunities within the marine industry.
Assist with the shipping and receiving functions to help facilitate the trafficking and accountability for all materials received and delivered for customer orders, inventory, repairs, or for internal use.
Direct service requests the appropriate team member.
Maintain work area and stockroom in a clean and orderly fashion.
Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped using Mackay’s ERP system.

title: Especialista em vendas no balcão (otc)
description:
A Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviços de eletrônica náutica com mais de 500 funcionários em 60 centros de serviço em 22 países, incluindo Américas, África, Ásia e Europa. A Mackay oferece salários competitivos, além de horas extras, e benefícios como seguro saúde/odontológico, férias remuneradas, vale-refeição e vale-transporte.
 
A Mackay está buscando um Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) para o setor náutico, com experiência e proficiência em inglês, para trabalhar presencialmente em nossa unidade no Rio de Janeiro. Candidatos com as habilidades e qualificações descritas abaixo são encorajados a se candidatar.
 
RESUMO DA VAGA DE ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS NO BALCÃO (OTC)
O Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) é um cargo presencial, sem função gerencial, que se reporta ao Diretor Geral do Brasil. As responsabilidades do Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) incluem, entre outras, a comunicação direta com nossos clientes para responder a perguntas sobre disponibilidade, preço e uso de produtos, bem como fornecer orientação técnica, orçamentos em tempo hábil e propostas abrangentes. Processará transações no balcão, pedidos especiais, pedidos de vendas por telefone e internet, bem como transferências entre empresas. Dará suporte a outros membros da equipe, clientes e contas da empresa com pedidos e entrega de peças para apoiar nossos negócios.
 
As responsabilidades também incluirão manuseio de materiais e envio/recebimento de mercadorias, o que envolve levantamento físico, manuseio de caixas, paleteiras e pode incluir atividades em escadas, elevadores, empilhadeiras, ferramentas elétricas, ferramentas manuais, transporte e movimentação de peças e equipamentos.
 
REQUISITOS DO CARGO DE ESPECIALISTA EM ATENDIMENTO NO BALCÃO:
• Atuar como ponto de contato para vendas, serviços e solicitações de informações do cliente para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas com rapidez e profissionalismo.
• Auxiliar na pesquisa de problemas técnicos básicos sobre produtos e serviços. Coletar sintomas de problemas do cliente e facilitar os reparos.
• Auxiliar no atendimento de clientes em potencial ou ligações de clientes quando a equipe de vendas externas estiver fora do escritório.
• Fornecer orçamentos e propostas aos clientes e realizar o acompanhamento em tempo hábil.
• Desenvolver o negócio identificando oportunidades de receita no setor náutico.
• Auxiliar nas funções de expedição e recebimento para facilitar o fluxo e a contabilização de todos os materiais recebidos e entregues para pedidos de clientes, estoque, reparos ou uso interno.
• Direcionar solicitações de serviço ao membro da equipe apropriado.
• Manter a área de trabalho e o estoque limpos e organizados.
• Ler pedidos de clientes, ordens de serviço, ordens de envio ou requisições para determinar os itens a serem movidos, coletados, distribuídos e/ou enviados, utilizando o sistema ERP da Mackay.
 
HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE PRODUTOS DE BANCADA:
• Conhecimento prévio de equipamentos eletrônicos náuticos é um diferencial.
• Capacidade de ler e interpretar documentos como folhetos de produtos, instruções de operação e manutenção, manuais de procedimentos, etc.
• Capacidade de somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir em todas as unidades de medida, utilizando números inteiros, frações comuns e decimais. Capacidade de calcular taxas, proporções e porcentagens.
• Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de organizar materiais de forma eficaz e eficiente.
• Excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente, comunicação (oral e escrita), organização, planejamento e priorização.
 
QUALIFICAÇÕES PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE MEDICAMENTOS DE BANCADA:
• Dois anos de ensino superior.
• Experiência na área de eletrônica e/ou náutica é desejável.
• Três anos de experiência em vendas internas ou no balcão.
• Bons conhecimentos de informática e internet.
• Carteira de habilitação válida e veículo próprio.
 
Os candidatos devem estar autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil sem necessidade de patrocínio. A aprovação em uma verificação completa de antecedentes será exigida após a aceitação da oferta de emprego.

title: Electrical engineer
description:
Position: Electrical Engineer

About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Key Responsibilities
Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;
Develop technical solutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;
Provide technical support to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;
Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;
Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P& IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;
Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.
Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced English;
Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;
Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.
Nice to have
Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems.

Meal and food allowances

Life Insurance
Annual Bonus

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

description:
About Turing:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Key Qualifications:
Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.
Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying " Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.
Education & Experience:
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.
Offer Details:
Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
Engagement type: Contractor
Engagement Length: 3 months

title: Technical bim designer / computational revit specialist

The Technical BIM Designer will support Ecotone’s technical drafting and modeling workflows by developing detailed Revit models, coordinating with engineering consultants, and implementing automation tools that improve production efficiency and model quality.

Advanced Revit Expertise

• Worksharing environments

Candidates should be comfortable using Dynamo to:
• automate documentation tasks
• streamline modeling workflows
• enforce BIM standards
• reduce manual drafting work
Computational BIM Workflow Experience
Experience implementing data-driven BIM processes using Dynamo or similar tools to manage parameters, enforce standards, and perform automated quality control checks within large Revit models.
Design-Build Project Experience
Experience working in design-build or construction-integrated environments where BIM models directly support construction documentation, coordination, and fabrication.
Candidates should understand how digital models translate into construction outcomes.
Construction Documentation and Technical Detailing
Strong experience producing detailed construction documents in Revit.
Candidates should be comfortable developing:
• wall assemblies
• sections and details

Fabrication-Oriented Modeling
Experience producing highly detailed models that support:
• shop drawing development
• prefabrication workflows

Buildability Awareness
Working knowledge of construction sequencing, material tolerances, installation constraints, and contractor workflows.
Models and drawings must reflect real-world construction logic, not conceptual architecture.
Professional Experience Requirement
This role is intended for experienced BIM professionals.
Applicants who are early in their careers, seeking training in Revit fundamentals, or looking for entry-level drafting roles will not be considered.

Python within Dynamo
Ability to write custom Python scripts inside Dynamo to extend functionality and bypass node limitations.

Experience developing custom automation tools or add-ins using the Revit API.
Why Work at Ecotone
Ecotone offers the opportunity to work on technically complex projects that integrate architecture, engineering coordination, fabrication, and construction.
Team members gain exposure to:
• advanced BIM workflows
• construction-integrated design environments
• highly specialized architectural systems
• real-world design-build problem solving

title: Service Engineer
description: Job Summary:The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.In this role, your responsibilities will be: Onboard Service Execution: Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters. Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations. Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution: Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products. Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials. Reports / Administrative Activities: Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points. Onboard service reports must be signed by customers. Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner. Participation in FAT Tests: Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class. Training: Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson. Participate in, observe, and comply with the company's health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment. Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates. Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.Who You Are: You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.For this role, you will need: Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus. 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment. Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments. Availability to work overtime, as needed. Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel. Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken. Work location: Rio de Janeiro.Our Culture and Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

title: Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI
description: Estamos em busca de umCoordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TIque será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio. Seus desafios serão:Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia. Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS). Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT). Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes. Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos. Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho. Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP). Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores. Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade. Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.O que é necessário você ter:Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório). Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443. Experiência comprovada em: Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias. Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos. Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP. Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial. Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).O que temos para você:Vale Alimentação; Vale Refeição; Assistência médica; Assistência odontológica; Auxilio farmácia; Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados; Previdência privada; Wellhub; Seguro de vida; Convênio com empresas parceiras; Programa de treinamentos.

Vale transporte ou desconto em estacionamento; Seguro Saúde; Convênio Odontológico; Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais; Previdência Privada; Assistência a Viagens; Garantia Funeral; Auxílio Creche ou Babá; Realizar visitas aos clientes, identificar e oferecer através de análise do potencial de negócios do cliente, novos serviços, buscando alavancar negócios de pós vendas, desenvolvendo soluções para renovações e up grade das contas ativas da Cia; Responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente, visando assegurar a satisfação, atendimento, fidelização, rentabilização e a retenção dos clientes de todos os segmentos de negócios da Seguros Unimed; Realizar negociações dentro dos padrões e normas definidas pela empresa, através da orientação, análise e validação dos contratos comerciais, acompanhamento e monitoramento dos processos de negociações; Realizar vendas de produtos e soluções, de contas de médio porte e impacto financeiro, buscando o atingimento das metas de vendas, através do acompanhamento dos resultados, elaboração de planos de ações para expansão do mercado e desenvolvimento de novos mercados; title: HR Training Analyst
description: Position: HR Training AnalystLocation: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de JaneiroAbout Us MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services. For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.Job Purpose The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System. The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.Key Responsibilities Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment; Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System; Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE; Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs; Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices; Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations; Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes; Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses; Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management; Support audits and evaluations of training service providers; Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required; Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred; Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage); Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable; Fluent English (minimum intermediate level); Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities; Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.Benefits Meal and food allowances; Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay); Life Insurance; Annual Bonus; Private Pension Plan; Childcare Allowance.Note This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens. MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

Sobre nós


Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.


Como é atuar conosco


Por meio da nossa área de Alocação de Talentos, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.



Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E, você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Realizar entrada de mercadorias e serviços via MIGO no SAP;
  • Efetuar lançamento e conferência de notas fiscais de fornecedores via MIRO;
  • Validar notas fiscais com pedidos de compra (pedido x recebimento x NF – 3-way match);
  • Conferir impostos destacados nas NFs (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, entre outros);
  • Garantir correta classificação fiscal e contábil;
  • Apoiar na criação e liberação de pedidos de pagamento;
  • Atuar em interface com áreas de Compras, Financeiro e Contabilidade;
  • Apoiar em tratativas de divergências fiscais e financeiras.


Requisitos / Qualificações


  • Experiência prévia com MIGO e MIRO no SAP;
  • Vivência com conferência e lançamento de notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Conhecimento emimpostos indiretos;
  • Experiência em rotinas de contas a pagar será diferencial;
  • Excel intermediário;
  • Perfil organizado, detalhista e com senso de urgência.


O que esperamos de você


  • Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade naresolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
  • Boa comunicaçãoe relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Responsabilidade, organização e adaptabilidade;
  • Disposição paracolaborar com diferentes equipes e projetos;


Benefícios


  • Rede de academias;
  • Canal de apoio psicológico;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Gerente De Operações
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Operações para atuar na liderança e gestão de projetos, sendo responsável pelo planejamento, controle e execução de projetos industriais, navais e de óleo e gás, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, custos, qualidade, segurança e requisitos contratuais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, atualizar e garantir a execução do Plano de Execução do Projeto (PEP), abrangendo escopo, cronograma, orçamento, qualidade, QSMS e interfaces;
  • Planejar e controlar cronogramas detalhados (nível 3 ou 4), assegurando cumprimento do caminho crítico, alocação eficiente de recursos e mitigação de riscos;
  • Gerenciar custos, produtividade, riscos, mudanças e previsões financeiras, promovendo cultura de controle e melhoria contínua;
  • Liderar equipesmultidisciplinares (soldagem, elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, inspeção, NDT, estruturas, entre outras), promovendo engajamento, desenvolvimento e alta performance;
  • Gerenciar mobilizações, logística, materiais, equipamentos e certificações, garantindo prontidão operacional e compliance;
  • Assegurar a execução das atividades conforme procedimentos, desenhos, CTRs, normas técnicas e melhores práticas do setor;
  • Gerir equipes próprias e subcontratadas em atividades de construção, reparos, IMR e comissionamento;
  • Validar MTOs, garantindo aderência ao escopo, quantidades, especificações técnicas e rastreabilidade de materiais;
  • Monitorar progresso físico, produtividade e KPIs das frentes de trabalho, propondo ações corretivas quando necessário;
  • Garantir conformidade com as Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35, requisitos IACS, ABS, DNV e exigências dos clientes;
  • Implementar planos de qualidade e inspeção, gerenciar NCRs, testes, inspeções e punch lists
  • Liderar análises de risco e HAZIDs, garantindo a aplicação de medidas de controle em campo
  • Atuar como ponto focal operacional junto ao cliente, assegurando alinhamento e comunicação eficaz;
  • Conduzir reuniões, auditorias e inspeções técnicas e operacionais;
  • Emitir relatórios semanais e mensais com indicadores de prazo, custo, QSMS, progresso e produtividade;
  • Registrar evolução de escopo, desvios e justificativas;
  • Conduzir sessões de lições aprendidas e implementar melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter alinhamento constante com a área Comercial quanto a impactos operacionais e execução conforme escopo contratado.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Naval, Elétrica, Produção, Petróleo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos na área ou em função similar;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos EPC e IMR;
  • Vivência em projetos industriais, navais ou de óleo e gás;
  • Sólida experiência em planejamento, controle de custos, análise de produtividade e gestão de grandes equipes;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia EPC e gestão de projetos industriais;
  • Experiência comMS Project ou Primavera;
  • Conhecimento emERP (TOTVS/Fluig), plataformas de gestão de projetos e dashboards de BI;
  • Conhecimento das Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35;
  • Conhecimento dos requisitos IACS, ABS e DNV.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência em projetos para a Petrobras;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em gestão e melhoria de processos.

title: Especialista Em Bi
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Especialista em BI para se juntar à nossa equipe no Rio de Janeiro, RJ. Este cargo envolve o desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards, execução de processos de ETL e modelagem de dados para fornecer insights estratégicos. As atividades incluem análise de grandes volumes de dados, criação e otimização de relatórios e suporte às tomadas de decisão com base em informações analíticas. Este é um cargo em tempo integral com atuação presencial.

Qualificações

  • Habilidades analíticas e analítica de dados: Experiência em análise de dados e capacidade de traduzir dados complexos em informações acionáveis.
  • Dashboard e modelagem de dados: Capacidade de desenvolver e gerenciar dashboards e realizar modelagem de dados para apresentar tendências e métricas.
  • Processos de ETL: Domínio em práticas de extração, transformação e carregamento (ETL) de dados.
  • Formação em áreas como ciência da computação, engenharia ou análise de dados será um diferencial, assim como experiência com tecnologias e ferramentas modernas de BI.

title: Analista De Seguros Júnior -Vaga Exclusiva Para Pcd
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Realizar atendimentos aos clientes, respondendo a dúvidas, fornecendo informações e auxiliando em suas necessidades.
  • Verificar a conformidade dos processos de atendimento de acordo com as diretrizes e padrões estabelecidos.
  • Auxiliar na identificação de melhorias com base nos registros de atendimentos.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de atendimento e outras áreas para resolver problemas.
  • Acompanhar métricas e elaborar relatórios e apresentações.
  • Prestar suporte em cotações de seguros.
  • Controlar e resolver pendências de propostas e apólices de seguros.
  • Monitorar a regulação de sinistros.
  • Atualizar sistemas internos e planilhas de controle.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior completo.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Proatividade, com capacidade de antecipar etapas e considerar possíveis desdobramentos.
  • Experiência no mercado de seguros.

title: Nurse Offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.


Key Responsibilities

Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;

Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;

Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;

Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;

Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);

Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;

Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;

Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;

Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;

Provide First Aidtraining to designated first aid teams onboard;

Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);

Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.


Requirements

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced life support and emergency care training;

Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;

Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, CloudWatch), Angular (v19 or similar), RxJS / Observables, MyBatis and Liquibase.
  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.G., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.


Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.


Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.


This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. Qualifications

title: Especialista De Planejamento Tributário
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Acompanhamento e análise de alterações na legislação tributária e consultoria interna;

  • Estruturação denovas atividades, serviços e novos empreendimentos multiuso, incluindo pesquisa da legislação;
  • Análise contratual e simulação da alternativa fiscal mais eficiente;
  • Atuação em projetos de M&A, com foco em reestruturações societárias preparatórias para aquisições e vendas de ativos;
  • Identificação de oportunidades e condução da implementação de projetos, a fim de garantir a maximização dos resultados e a redução de riscos fiscais.

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou Direito;

  • Experiência sólida na área Tributária;

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do Cargo

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

Principais Atividades

1. Identificar e avaliar riscos operacionais, financeiros e de conformidade associados às atividades da empresa de energia renovável.

2. Executar auditorias internas periódicas para avaliar a eficácia dos controles internos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

3. Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações do setor, garantindo aderência aos controles internos.

4. Fornecer treinamento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre práticas e controles internos, fomentando cultura de conformidade.

5. Desenvolver protocolos para tratamento de incidentes de não conformidade, investigando irregularidades e definindo medidas corretivas.

6. Preparar relatórios regulares sobre desempenho dos controles internos, com análises e recomendações à alta administração.

7. Colaborar com TI para integrar controles internos aos sistemas corporativos, promovendo abordagem sistêmica.

8. Avaliar eficiência e eficácia dos processos de negócio, propondo melhorias para otimização e redução de riscos.

9. Facilitar auditorias externas, garantindo fornecimento de documentação e informações necessárias.

10. Efetuar os testes e análises de acordo com as instruções do Grupo para o programa global de controles internos.

Unidades: Rio de Janeiro | São Paulo | Porto Alegre


Principais atividades:

  • Realizar consultas dermatológicas focadas na saúde da pele, cabelo e unhas, identificando patologias e condições estéticas.
  • Diagnosticar e tratar doenças dermatológicas (acne, melasma, rosácea, dermatites, etc.).

Microagulhamento. Bioestimuladores de colágeno. Tratamentos para flacidez e gordura localizada (conforme especialização e equipamentos da clínica).
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes pós-procedimentos, garantindo a segurança e os resultados esperados.
  • Prescrever medicamentos e dermocosméticos, orientando sobre o uso adequado.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as últimas tendências, tecnologias e pesquisas na área da dermatologia clínica e estética.
  • Colaborar com a equipe multidisciplinar da clínica (esteticistas, fisioterapeutas, enfermeiros) para um plano de tratamento integrado.
  • Participar de treinamentos e reuniões da equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços.
  • Garantir a ética e a biossegurança em todos os procedimentos e interações com os pacientes.


Requisitos:

  • Formação completa em Medicina, com residência médica em Dermatologia reconhecida pelo MEC e pela SBD (Sociedade Brasileira de Dermatologia).
  • Registro ativo no CRM (Conselho Regional de Medicina) e RQE (Registro de Qualificação de Especialista) em Dermatologia.
  • Experiência comprovada em procedimentos dermatológicos estéticos e tratamentos clínicos.

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação ou cursos complementares em Dermatologia Estética ou áreas afins.

  • Portfólio de casos de sucesso.

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.


Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered .

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.
